title: CellProfiler: Novel Automated Image Segmentation Procedure for Super-Resolution Microscopy
author: Soliman

steps.title: Apply Gaussian smoothing
steps.instruction: In CellProfiler (version 2.1.1) add a Smooth module and apply a Gaussian filter with an artifact diameter chosen to merge only nanoscopic clusters of the two virtual active zones while still allowing the zones to be distinguished.

steps.title: Identify active zones
steps.instruction: Add an IdentifyPrimaryObject module and set it to use Maximum Correlation Thresholding (MCT) as described in the Materials and Methods; MCT is implemented with 1‑pixel Gaussian smoothing.

steps.title: De‑clump fused active zones
steps.instruction: Enable de‑clumping of the fused active‑zone objects by searching for shape indentations (shape‑based algorithm) to separate individual active zones.

steps.title: Identify single‑molecule clusters
steps.instruction: Add a second IdentifyPrimaryObject module to locate single‑molecule clusters within each active zone, using the same MCT thresholding as before.

steps.title: De‑clump clustered molecules
steps.instruction: Configure de‑clumping for the identified clusters by using maximum‑intensity watershed: divide clumped objects based on the maximum intensity within a radius range, setting the distance for lower‑maxima suppression manually to the median radius of the object sizes.

steps.title: Relate clusters to active zones
steps.instruction: Insert a RelateObjects module to link each cluster (child) to its parent active zone, choosing the appropriate parent/child relationship.

steps.title: Visualize and export results
steps.instruction: Use a DisplayHistogram module to plot the number of clusters per active zone, then export the measurements to a spreadsheet with ExportToSpreadsheet; further plotting can be performed in OriginPro 9.1.
